name: OpenVibe.Host

exposure.note: the domain serves the OpenVibe.Sites placeholder page

site.name: Host
site.what: The network's deployment plane first, then simple hosting for community sites, bots and mods.

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP (the Host API on 4910; the ovhost CLI is not a daemon); it checks nothing else (the database and dependencies are what ready checks)

drains: worker stopped (domain checks, object sweep, outbox prune)

resumes.what: pending custom domains are checked again; objects no deploy references and interrupted temp files are swept after an hour
unsent events in the outbox table go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts (at least once; Events dedupes by event_id)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: the schema code only adds (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN; no DROP, RENAME or table rebuild), which an older release ignores

claims.what: one ovhost operation at a time per service (deploy and rollback; a drill and backup --all take their own locks)
claims.holder: the ovhost process: <stateDir>/locks/<service>.lock holds its pid
claims.fencing: a lock whose pid is no longer alive is removed and taken again (exclusive create); a live holder refuses the second operation

notes: Stage A: the ovhost operator CLI (no server). Stage B: the Host API service on port 4910 (unit openvibe-host.service, state /var/lib/openvibe-host-api): tenant projects keyed by project id (prj_, network_project_id once Network has projects, ADR-014), static sites served by Host header at <site>.openvibe.host (a registrable domain separate from every other OpenVibe domain) and on TXT-verified custom domains, immutable content-addressed deploys with rollback, quotas enforced here, upload logs. Consumes OpenVibe.Network (SSO, JWKS, client-credentials) and publishes through OpenVibe.Events (events.event.publish). The ovhost CLI publishes host.release.published (subject release, visibility public) when a network service's release goes live (ovhost deploy/rollback/announce; release notifications, WS-P task 9); host.deploy.activated is Stage B's tenant activations only. Stage C (sandboxed user code) is not started.
